result.instructions: Tools for ChargeOver, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which invoices are unpaid right now and what is the total balance?"; "List the active subscriptions for customer Acme Ltd."; "Show payments and refunds we processed last month.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes ChargeOver data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run chargeover_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run chargeover_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run chargeover_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. chargeover_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: chargeover_list_customers
tools.title: List or search customers
tools.description: List customers (companies that are billed). Filterable fields: customer_id, parent_customer_id, bill_state, ship_state, bill_country, ship_country, external_key, token, company, superuser_id, superuser_email, customer_status_state (a = active, i = inactive), customer_status_str (active-current, active-overdue, inactive-manual, inactive-activity), custom_1..custom_50, write_datetime, mod_datetime. Paged: pass next_offset as offset. GET /customer.

filters.description: Filters, all combined with AND. Example: [{field:'customer_id',op:'EQUALS',value:12},{field:'date',op:'GTE',value:'2026-01-01'}].

field.description: Filter field (the list tool's description names the valid ones).

op.description: EQUALS, NOTEQUALS, GT, GTE, LT, LTE, CONTAINS (substring), IS:NULL or ISNOT:NULL (no value).

value.description: The value to compare with; omit for IS:NULL / ISNOT:NULL.

order.description: Sort as field:ASC or field:DESC, for example invoice_id:DESC.

offset.description: Records to skip (default 0). Use next_offset from the previous reply.

tools.name: chargeover_get_customer
tools.title: Get a customer
tools.description: Get one customer by customer_id: company, status, addresses, primary contact, terms, balance fields, custom fields. GET /customer/{customer_id}.

tools.name: chargeover_get_contact
tools.title: Get a contact
tools.description: Get one contact (user) by user_id: name, email, phone, username, the customers they belong to. GET /user/{user_id}.

tools.name: chargeover_get_invoice
tools.title: Get an invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice by invoice_id: status, line items, totals, balance, payments and credits applied, billing address. GET /invoice/{invoice_id}.

tools.name: chargeover_get_transaction
tools.title: Get a transaction (read only)
tools.description: Get one transaction (payment, refund or credit that already happened) by transaction_id: amount, method, status, the invoices it was applied to, related refunds. GET /transaction/{transaction_id}.

tools.name: chargeover_get_quote
tools.title: Get a quote
tools.description: Get one quote by quote_id: status, line items, totals, memo, links to the invoice or subscription it became. GET /quote/{quote_id}.

tools.name: chargeover_get_subscription
tools.title: Get a subscription
tools.description: Get one subscription (package) by package_id: status, payment cycle, pay method, next invoice date, line items. GET /package/{package_id}.

tools.name: chargeover_get_item
tools.title: Get an item
tools.description: Get one item (product, service or discount) by item_id: name, type, SKU, pricing tiers per currency. GET /item/{item_id}.

tools.name: chargeover_list_reports
tools.title: List reports
tools.description: List the account's saved reports (report_id and name). Run one with chargeover_run_report. GET /_report.

tools.name: chargeover_get_report
tools.title: Get a report's definition
tools.description: A report's name, its available_filters (field names and allowed operators), available_columns and default_columns. Read this before chargeover_run_report to know which filters and columns to use. GET /_report/{report_id}.

tools.name: chargeover_run_report
tools.title: Run a report
tools.description: Run a saved report and return its rows (read only; nothing is changed). Filters use the report's own field names from chargeover_get_report, for example [{field:'transaction_transaction_date',op:'GTE',value:'2026-01-01'}]. Operators vary by field (dates GTE/LTE/EQUALS, ids EQUALS, strings CONTAINS/DOES_NOT_CONTAIN). To page (offset > 0) an order is required. Max 1000 rows per page. POST /_report/{report_id}/_action/reportData.

columns.description: Column names to return (default: the report's default columns).

order.description: Sort as field:ASC or field:DESC, for example invoice_id:DESC.

offset.description: Records to skip (default 0). Use next_offset from the previous reply.

tools.name: chargeover_create_customer
tools.title: Create a customer
tools.description: WRITE: create a new customer (no charge, no invoice, no email is sent by this call). Returns the new customer_id. Add a primary contact with the superuser_* fields. Use chargeover_list_customers first to avoid a duplicate (external_key is unique). POST /customer.

parent_customer_id.description: Parent customer id, to create a child customer.

external_key.description: Your own unique id for the customer (cannot be reused by default, even after deletion).

tools.name: chargeover_update_customer
tools.title: Update a customer
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing customer; send only the fields to change. Cannot touch payment methods, balances or status. Replaces the previous values of the fields you send. PUT /customer/{customer_id}.

external_key.description: Your own unique id for the customer (cannot be reused by default, even after deletion).

tools.name: chargeover_create_contact
tools.title: Add a contact to a customer
tools.description: WRITE: add a contact (person) to an existing customer. No email is sent by this call. Returns the new user_id. POST /user.

customer_id.description: The customer the contact belongs to.

name.description: Full name (alternative to first_name and last_name).

external_key.description: Your own unique id for the contact.

annotations.title: Add a contact to a customer

tools.name: chargeover_create_note
tools.title: Add a note
tools.description: WRITE: add a note to a customer, subscription, invoice, contact, quote or item (shown in the ChargeOver UI to the team; never sent to the customer). Returns the note id. POST /note.

context_str.description: What the note is attached to (billing_package = a subscription, user = a contact).

context_id.description: The id of that record (customer_id, package_id, invoice_id, user_id, quote_id or item_id).

tools.name: chargeover_create_quote
tools.title: Create a quote
tools.description: WRITE: create a quote (a proposal) for an existing customer. Nothing is billed and no email is sent: the quote stays open until someone sends or accepts it in ChargeOver. Each line refers to an existing item (chargeover_list_items). paycycle: one = one-time invoice, mon = monthly, 2mn = every 2 months, qtr = quarterly, six = every 6 months, yrl = yearly, 2yr, 3yr, 1wk = weekly, 2wk. Returns the new quote_id. POST /quote.

customer_id.description: The customer the quote is for.

expire_recurs.description: Number of invoices before the line expires.

refnumber.description: Your reference number for the quote.

memo.description: Memo shown to the customer on the quote.

external_key.description: Your own unique id for the quote.
